description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'ext::cmd remote connect' helper in a Git environment. It defines several test cases for Git operations involving external commands and a fake Git daemon setup.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specified setup commands.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script file with given content, used here to set up a fake daemon.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock, used to simulate the passage of time between commits.
